nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 沿 Stanley Park 海堤骑行时，你在长椅下发现一台旧胶片相机。最后一张照片停在取景框里：红围巾、白帆和远处的雪山。

nodes.speaker: Noah
nodes.text: Let's find the owner before sunset. Start with a clear description — details travel faster than guesses.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 前方的租车亭正在播放失物招领广播，工作人员示意你描述物品。

options.text: 「We found a small silver film camera near the seawall.」

nodes.speaker: 工作人员
nodes.text: Perfect. Location, colour, and type — that gives the owner something specific to recognise.

nodes.speaker: Noah
nodes.text: Add what it looks like and where we found it. 'Over there' disappears the moment we move.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 广播刚结束，一位戴红围巾的女士气喘吁吁地跑来。她能说出相机皮套内侧刻着的两个字母。

options.text: 「Could you describe one photo still on the roll?」

nodes.speaker: 女士
nodes.text: A white sail beneath the mountains. It was the last photo my father took here twenty years ago.

nodes.speaker: Noah
nodes.text: One quick check first. Returning something safely means being kind and careful at the same time.

nodes.speaker: 女士
nodes.text: Thank you. I came back to take the same photograph for him. Would you press the shutter?

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 你等到白帆进入雪山之间，轻轻按下快门。旧相机发出一声清脆的咔哒，像两段时间终于接上。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 【获得 120 金币】你继续沿海堤前行，开始留意每一个值得被准确描述的细节。
